second_sentence.second: The comparison rests on 10 pairs (5 in winter 2024-25 and 5 in winter 2025-26) in 4 cold spells. It does not estimate the difference for the 4 novel days that could not be matched (10 January 2025, 20 November 2025, 4 January 2026, 5 January 2026), which include the coldest days, or for the full cold tail.
